item.title: Rooftop Jazz in Two Formats

turns.text: I need the same 10-second Rooftop Jazz promo in 9:16 for Stories and 16:9 for a venue screen. Sunset rooftop, musicians playing, mellow jazz, no voiceover. Show 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable.

item.tests: Checks delivery of two correctly composed aspect-ratio variants with matching event content, readable overlays and no letterboxing.

answer_sheet.Deliverables and sizes: Two separate 10-second videos: one 9:16 for Stories and one 16:9 for a venue screen.
answer_sheet.Exact event text: Rooftop Jazz; 18 July 2026; Sky Terrace, Manchester
answer_sheet.Visual style: Musicians playing on a rooftop at sunset, with matching styling across both versions.
answer_sheet.Audio: Mellow jazz in both versions, no voiceover.

must_haves: Two separate playable videos are delivered, each 10 seconds long: one 9:16 and one 16:9.
Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and event content.
Both versions display exactly 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
All three text lines are fully inside each frame and readable together for at least 3 seconds.
Both compositions fill their frames without black bars, stretched imagery or cropped-off musicians' faces.
Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover.

turns.text: I need the same 10-second Rooftop Jazz promo in 9:16 for Stories and 16:9 for a venue screen. Sunset rooftop, musicians playing, mellow jazz, no voiceover. Show 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent any credits.**

For two full-frame, 10-second versions, the documented 480p production-workflow estimate is:

| Item | Credits |
|---|---:|
| 9:16 Stories video — 10 seconds × 24 | 240 |
| 16:9 venue-screen video — 10 seconds × 24 | 240 |
| One shared 10-second mellow-jazz music track | 10 |
| **Estimated total** | **490** |

That uses free-plan-compatible video settings, with no voiceover. I can’t check your live balance with the available tools, so this is a workflow estimate—not confirmation that your account can afford it.

### Cheaper options
- **Two 5-second versions:** approximately **245 credits**, including one shared 5-second music bed.
- **Generate one 10-second video, then reframe it in a free editor:** approximately **250 credits** including music. This also gives you genuinely matching footage; two separate generations will differ.
- **Lowest-cost approach:** generate a sunset-rooftop still, then add a slow zoom, text and music in a free editor. A basic free-plan image starts at **5 credits**, with music/licensing handled separately.

**480p is the lowest resolution offered by this production workflow.** It’s suitable for a budget preview, but may look soft on a large venue screen.

For readable text, I recommend adding these as **fixed text overlays**, rather than asking the video model to draw the lettering:
- Rooftop Jazz
- 18 July 2026
- Sky Terrace, Manchester

Each layout should fill its frame without black bars, with text positioned separately for portrait and landscape. Reframing one source may crop out some musicians.

**Important:** Magic Hour’s guide says commercial use requires a paid subscription, a credit-pack purchase or an agreed paid usage arrangement. An event promo appears to fall under that, so free-plan model access alone isn’t sufficient.

Would you prefer the **490-credit two-version plan**, the **shorter 245-credit option**, or the **still-image budget approach**? I won’t run a paid generation without your approval.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that — the still-image budget approach.

dialog.agent:
Before spending credits, one budget choice:

- **One still: from 5 credits** — reuse and crop it for both formats in a free editor.
- **Two formatted stills: from 10 credits total** — one 9:16 and one 16:9, with more room to keep the musicians and text readable.

These would be **640px images**, not finished videos. The 10-second zoom, exact text overlays and licensed jazz track would be added in the editor.

Would you like **one still at the lowest cost**, or **two formatted stills**? Nothing has been generated yet.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that — one still at the lowest cost.

dialog.agent: Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.user: Yes: 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Please keep all the text readable in both formats.

style.prompt: Create one polished event-promo still, portrait 9:16. Sunset rooftop terrace in Manchester, warm amber sky, intimate live jazz ensemble playing instruments, mellow sophisticated atmosphere, cinematic photographic event artwork. Crucial dual-format crop-safe design: the portrait image will also be cropped to a full-frame 16:9 landscape using the central 31.6 percent of its height. Keep ALL lettering entirely inside the middle horizontal band from 37% to 62% of total image height, with generous left/right margins. Three exact clearly separated lines, large high-contrast clean typography on a dark softly shaded central area: 'Rooftop Jazz' then '18 July 2026' then 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Spell all text exactly. No other text, no logos. Keep title largest and venue line clearly readable. Musicians and instruments visible around and behind the central text, not obscuring letters. Position key musicians near the middle band so some performance context survives the landscape crop. Extend rooftop, sky and warm ambient lighting above and below for full-frame portrait composition. No border, no mockup.
